claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Farmer/AgroVIR data minimised and coded/anonymised; results published aggregated/anonymised.
Durable scientific contribution is a prospectively tested validation framework against independent ground truth.
Methodological knowledge forms a basis for controlled crop-by-crop extension, not universalisation.
Development crop processing tomato (2022-2026); no fixed-percentage water-saving promise.
Published water-saving effects ~8-30% cited as bounded literature context only.
~30% vs empirical and ~7.5% vs ET-based (Carucci et al. 2023), bounded context.
~25% saving without significant yield loss under early controlled deficit (Badr et al. 2026), bounded context.
Project's own value = correct stress detection, lead time, uncertainty honesty, usability, irrigation-attention.
Water-saving quantification claimed only if the farmer-field treatment arrangement supports it.
Crop-configurable DrR MVP as research-to-testing vehicle; economic value via measured quantities.
Named deliverables (model card; crop-transfer spec; transferability report M18; MVP M24; AgroVIR assessment M30; roadmap M30).
Eurostat ~2.0M ha fresh vegetables (2023) and ~0.7M EU farms (2020) as potential domain scale.
Bulgaria ~35.6k ha vegetable area and ~128k t tomato (2024) as downstream replication context.
FIELDWISE contributes to SDG 2, 6, 12, 13.
Eleven-KPI set (K1-K11), each measuring something delivered and tracing to a named deliverable.
Post-MSCA MVCRI replication route extends reach beyond the 24-month programme without in-action effort.
30-month project: 24-month EF at ATK plus 6-month AgroVIR placement.
